localization_error.alignment_rule: per episode, model pose is anchored to the evaluator truth pose of the same window's first tick; scored ticks are unique and listed per episode

loop_closure.message: no scored episode contained a non-consecutive revisit; the loop-closure segment is not replaced by a zero

unseen.alignment_rule: per episode, model pose is anchored to the evaluator truth pose of the same window's first tick; scored ticks are unique and listed per episode

unseen_map_generalization.alignment_rule: per episode, model pose is anchored to the evaluator truth pose of the same window's first tick; scored ticks are unique and listed per episode

topology_recovery.aggregation: macro mean over per-episode edge precision/recall against that episode's own visited-cell truth graph

8.reason: no development world supplied k support transitions plus a held-out query

few_shot_unseen_transition.support_rule: support writes only model memory (no parameter update); query transitions are disjoint and follow the support prefix in the same world

probe.truth_rule: truth is read only by this scorer after each forward pass; it is never an input to the model or its memory

m2_memory_interference.definition: all probes are the same fixed development probe; history is written from another world; the new-world write happens after the history probe without parameter updates; parameters are hashed before and after

details.name: equivariant metric map + episodic topology graph
